messages.subject: Issue with modulus operator?
parts:
Is there a modulus operator for integers in stan modelling language? Like % in C or %% in R?

The manual states that the modulus function fmod for real values "

can seriously hinder sampling and optimization efficiency for gradient-based methods (e.g., NUTS, HMC, BFGS) if applied to parameters (includ- ing transformed parameters and local variables in the transformed parameters or model block)."

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Issue with modulus operator?
parts:
No, but we should probably add one.

https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/issues/577

This would also be an easy issue to knock off for someone
looking to get their feet with with Stan development.

- Bob
